n3cfddf5fbc.summary: KenGen cut its dividend by 16.67% to 75 cents per share for the year to June 2026, from 90 cents, after reporting a marginal drop in earnings.

n62133d078b.headline: Holiday Halt: Why NYSE, Nasdaq are closed for trading today
n62133d078b.summary: Wall Street is closed on Monday, September 7, for Labor Day. Stronger August jobs data has raised expectations of tighter Fed policy, with CPI inflation data next.
n62133d078b.why: The NYSE and Nasdaq are the largest US equity venues, and the Fed's policy path shapes valuations across global markets.

n1ab487ced0.headline: Stock market today: Nifty, Sensex to open flat as US-Iran tensions push up crude oil prices
n1ab487ced0.summary: Gift Nifty traded near 24,000 ahead of Monday's session, with renewed geopolitical risk, elevated oil prices and US Treasury yields weighing on sentiment.
n1ab487ced0.why: The Nifty 50 and Sensex are India's benchmark equity indices, and India is a large importer of crude oil.

n3475fd10f6.headline: India boosts coal rail shipments as power plants face critically low stocks
n3475fd10f6.summary: India is increasing coal rail shipments as 58 power plants report critically low stocks. Heavy rains are disrupting mining and fuel transport in key states.
n3475fd10f6.why: Coal fuels a large share of India's electricity generation, so shortages at power plants can affect grid reliability and industrial output.

n342843df38.headline: Gold eases as robust US payrolls boost rate-hike bets; inflation data in focus
n342843df38.summary: Gold prices edged lower as strong US jobs data reinforced expectations for higher interest rates. Investors are awaiting key US inflation figures due later in the week.
n342843df38.why: Gold pays no interest, so it tends to weigh when expectations for higher US interest rates strengthen.
n342843df38.why_moved: Strong US payrolls reinforced expectations of higher interest rates, which weighed on the non-yielding metal.

n40c57f4068.headline: Crude oil prices rise as US-Iran strikes raise fears of prolonged Hormuz supply disruption
n40c57f4068.summary: Brent crude futures climbed 52 cents to $96.80 a barrel, while WTI rose 66 cents to $92.14. The gains followed US-Iran strikes that raised fears of prolonged Hormuz supply disruption.
n40c57f4068.why: Brent and WTI are the benchmark crude oil futures that set global energy costs for refiners, airlines and consumers. Supply shocks in the Gulf feed directly into these prices.
n40c57f4068.why_moved: US-Iran strikes raised fears that disruption to Hormuz supply would last. Those fears pushed both Brent and WTI higher.

n2a3ed46c85.headline: PVR Inox shares crash 8% after alleged Rs 200 crore kickback investigation; company issues clarification
n2a3ed46c85.summary: PVR Inox shares fell steeply after reports of an internal probe into alleged kickbacks of Rs 200 crore. The company said a senior executive's April exit was for personal reasons and launched a buyback.
n2a3ed46c85.why: PVR Inox is one of India's largest multiplex cinema operators, and governance concerns can weigh on its share price and investor confidence.

nd2d84c8860.headline: Crude oil futures rise as US, Iran attack each other’s ships
nd2d84c8860.summary: Crude oil futures traded higher on Monday morning after the US and Iran attacked each other's ships over the weekend. The report gives no further price figures.
nd2d84c8860.why: Crude oil futures are the main global benchmark for oil prices, which affect fuel costs, inflation and energy company earnings.
nd2d84c8860.why_moved: Attacks by the US and Iran on each other's ships raise the risk of disruption to oil shipments, lifting crude futures.

ncd1367554c.headline: Stock Market Highlights, Sensex Today: Sensex Settles 380 Points Lower Amid US-Iran Tensions

ncd1367554c.why: The BSE Sensex is India's benchmark equity index, and India is a large importer of crude oil, so oil price spikes affect Indian markets.
ncd1367554c.why_moved: Tensions between the US and Iran and strikes on oil vessels in Hormuz pushed crude toward $100, which weighed on Indian stocks.

n71ab3e8be5.headline: Markets open lower as strong US jobs data revives rate hike fears; IT stocks drag
n71ab3e8be5.summary: Indian markets opened lower after Wall Street fell on strong US August payrolls of 162,000, well above estimates. IT stocks dragged the market.
n71ab3e8be5.why: The Sensex is India's benchmark equity index, tracking the country's largest listed companies. Rate expectations in the US influence global capital flows into emerging markets.
n71ab3e8be5.why_moved: Strong US non-farm payrolls revived expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes, after a Wall Street sell-off on Friday. IT stocks weighed on the Indian index.

n9ca4d03ad7.summary: The Reserve Bank of India likely intervened in the foreign exchange market on Monday, boosting the rupee to 94.42 per dollar. The move came amid rising oil prices.

naa9f366162.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmark indices of Indian equities, tracking the largest listed companies on the National Stock Exchange and BSE.

n616795dc13.headline: Inflation likely to stay elevated until 2027 amid sticky price pressures
